analysis: Depression is a known side effect of propranolol, reserpine, and flupenthixol. Propranolol, a beta-blocker, can lead to mood changes including depression. Reserpine, an antihypertensive, has been associated with depression due to its mechanism of depleting monoamine neurotransmitters. Flupenthixol, an antipsychotic, also lists depression as a potential side effect. However, while oral contraceptives have been debated regarding their link to mood changes, they are not directly linked to causing depression as a common side effect.
